page.overview:
What is The Unnamed Feeling?

The Unnamed Feeling is the ninth track off of St. Anger. The song deals with stress and anxiety, connecting with the rest of the album in terms of themes.

The Unnamed Feeling is a song that talks about the intense and paralyzing feeling of anxiety or dread. It is about the feeling of losing control. James Hetfield, the lead singer, described it as a familiar battle with inner conflict and panic. The song really captures that time when logical thinking fades away into total chaos, which often happens during tough personal times or when someone is feeling depressed.

Been here before couldn’t say I liked it Do I start writing all this down? Just let me plug you into my world Can’t you help me be uncrazy?

Name this for me, heat the cold air Take the chill off of my life And if I could I’d turn my eyes To look inside to see what’s comin’
